'''Yasaman Farzan''' ({{langx|fa|یاسمن فرزان}} was born 1977 in [[Tabriz]]) is an Iranian researcher. She is a faculty member of [[Institute for Research in Fundamental Sciences]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Yasaman Farzan Awarded 2008 IUPAP Prize|url=http://www.ictp.it/about-ictp/media-centre/news/news-archive/2008/5/yasaman-farzan-awarded-2008-iupap-prize.aspx|work=[[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]]|archive-date=2015-05-23|access-date=2015-05-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150523150604/http://www.ictp.it/about-ictp/media-centre/news/news-archive/2008/5/yasaman-farzan-awarded-2008-iupap-prize.aspx|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=YASAMAN FARZAN|url=http://www.ipm.ac.ir/personalinfo.jsp?PeopleCode=IP0400070|work=[[Institute for Research in Fundamental Sciences]]}}</ref>

==Awards ==
* [[Khwarizmi International Award|The Kharazmi young scientist Award]] in 2006<ref name="physics.ipm">{{cite news|url= http://physics.ipm.ac.ir/people/farzan/ |title=Yasaman Farzan |publisher=physics.ipm }}</ref>
* Young Scientist Prize of the International Union of Pure and Applied Physics (IUPAP) in 2008<ref name="physics.ipm" />
* [[ICTP Prize|International Centre for Theoretical Physics Prize]] in 2013<ref>{{cite news|title=ICTP Prize Winners 2013|url=http://www.ictp.it/about-ictp/prizes-awards/the-ictp-prize/the-prize-winners-(1)/ictp-prize-winners-2013.aspx|work=[[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]]|archive-date=2015-05-11|access-date=2015-05-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150511124208/http://www.ictp.it/about-ictp/prizes-awards/the-ictp-prize/the-prize-winners-%281%29/ictp-prize-winners-2013.aspx|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=2013 ICTP prize awarded to Dr. Yasaman Farzan|url=http://www.invisibles.eu/news/2013-ictp-prize-awarded-dr-yasaman-farzan|work=invisibles|archive-date=2015-05-23|access-date=2015-05-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150523170234/http://www.invisibles.eu/news/2013-ictp-prize-awarded-dr-yasaman-farzan|url-status=dead}}</ref>
